name: MonarchCopyButton
title: CopyButton
summary: A button that copies a string to the clipboard, plays the confirm haptic, announces "Copied to clipboard" and, below Android 13, shows a short "Copied" state.
whenToUse: Next to a value people paste elsewhere: a link, an ID, an API key, a command.
whenNotToUse: To send a link to another app use the Sharesheet (ShareButton), which already offers Copy. Do not put a copy button on text the user can select and copy in place unless the value is long or hidden.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCopyButton(value: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, sensitive: Boolean = false, showConfirmation: Boolean = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU, resetAfterMillis: Long = 2000L, target: String? = null, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, copiedIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onCopy: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, label: String? = null, copiedLabel: String? = null, copiedAnnouncement: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchCopyButton(value: String, icon: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, sensitive: Boolean = false, showConfirmation: Boolean = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU, resetAfterMillis: Long = 2000L, target: String? = null, copiedIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onCopy: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, label: String? = null, copiedLabel: String? = null, copiedAnnouncement: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: value
options.description: The text to copy, written as a plain-text clip.

options.name: icon
options.description: Icon-only overload: the copy icon. Passing it selects that overload. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: leadingIcon
options.description: Text overload: an icon before the label.

options.name: variant
options.description: Primary, Secondary, Ghost or Danger. Text overload only; the icon-only button has no fill.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm, Md or Lg. Text overload only.

options.name: sensitive
options.description: Marks the clip with ClipDescription.EXTRA_IS_SENSITIVE, so Android 13 and later hide its content in the clipboard preview.

options.name: showConfirmation
options.description: Shows the copied label and copiedIcon after a copy. Android 13 and later show their own clipboard confirmation, so it is off there by default.

options.name: resetAfterMillis
options.description: How long the copied state lasts. Zero keeps it until the button leaves the composition.

options.name: target
options.description: What is copied, added to the spoken name: "Copy webhook URL". Also the label of the clip.

options.name: copiedIcon
options.description: The icon of the copied state, such as a check mark. Without it the idle icon stays.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Called with the copied text after each copy.

options.name: copiedAnnouncement
options.description: Replaces the built-in state "Copied to clipboard" (monarch_copybutton_copied_announcement).

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press, focus and hover interactions.

states.name: copied
states.description: For resetAfterMillis: TalkBack reads "Copied to clipboard" as the state. With showConfirmation the label reads "Copied" and copiedIcon replaces the icon. A second copy restarts the time.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The disabled colors of the variant; taps do nothing.

appearance: The text button has the colors of its MonarchButton variant. The icon-only button has no fill and uses the default text color, or the disabled text color when disabled. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web component has an error state because a browser can refuse a clipboard write; writing with the Android Clipboard does not report a failure, so there is no error state, as on iOS. The web value can be a function or a promise; here it is a string. Monarch bundles no icons, so the copy and check icons are slots. Android 13 and later show a system confirmation of every copy, and Android asks apps not to duplicate it, so the visual copied state is off there by default (showConfirmation); the spoken "Copied to clipboard" is kept on every version, because whether TalkBack reads the system confirmation was not verified. Android adds sensitive, which hides passwords and keys in the system preview. The icon-only form is a separate overload over the Material 3 IconButton; the web default variant for it is ghost, which matches.
accessibility: The text form is a MonarchButton and the icon-only form an IconButton, so each has the Button role, its disabled state and a touch target of at least 48dp.
The spoken name is the label followed by target ("Copy webhook URL"), so several copy buttons on a screen have different names. With the icon-only form the label is still the name.
The button is a polite live region; after a copy its state description is "Copied to clipboard" until the copied state ends, so TalkBack announces it.
With showConfirmation the copied state is a changed label and, when given, a changed icon, not a color.
Both labels share one cell, so the button keeps the width of the longer one; at font scale 2.0 the label wraps and the button grows.
The icon is at the start in both layout directions.
The confirm haptic follows the system haptics setting.
edgeCases: resetAfterMillis of zero keeps the copied state until the button leaves the composition.
The icon (or leadingIcon) is the idle icon; the copied icon is a separate slot.
The value is written as a plain-text clip and replaces what was on the clipboard.
Below Android 13 the sensitive flag is written but ignored by the system.

examples.title: Labels and icon-only
examples.template:
Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
    MonarchCopyButton(
        value = {{buttons.0.value}},
        target = {{buttons.0.target}},
    )
    MonarchCopyButton(
        value = {{buttons.1.value}},
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.{{buttons.1.variant|pascal}},
        label = {{buttons.1.label}},
        copiedLabel = {{buttons.1.copiedLabel}},
    )
    MonarchCopyButton(
        value = {{buttons.2.value}},
        icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Copy, contentDescription = null) },
        label = {{buttons.2.label}},
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.{{buttons.2.variant|pascal}},
        size = MonarchButtonSize.{{buttons.2.size|pascal}},
    )
}
examples.code:
Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
    MonarchCopyButton(
        value = "https://example.com/hooks/inbound",
        target = "webhook URL",
    )
    MonarchCopyButton(
        value = "https://example.com/s/q3-plan",
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
        label = "Copy link",
        copiedLabel = "Link copied",
    )
    MonarchCopyButton(
        value = "ws_01HZX4",
        icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Copy, contentDescription = null) },
        label = "Copy workspace ID",
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost,
        size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm,
    )
}

examples.title: Icon only, for a key
examples.code:
MonarchCopyButton(
    value = "sk_live_example_1234",
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Copy, contentDescription = null) },
    sensitive = true,
    target = "API key",
    onCopy = { copies += 1 },
)

parityExceptions.reason: the icon-only button is the icon overload of MonarchCopyButton (no text), not a flag
The web label of this button joins its visible text and hidden text with no separator; on Android the button is named with a sentence for TalkBack and its visible text is shown as it is.
parityExceptions.convention: a control is named in a sentence, not by concatenated visible text (Material accessibility)
